stem:
Daria has 42 baseball gloves in her store.

She will put these gloves on 7 shelves. She will put the same number of gloves on each shelf. How many gloves will Daria put on each shelf?
visual_elements: 42 gray baseball gloves arranged in rows
difficulty_rationale: The problem involves a straightforward division to equally distribute 42 items into 7 groups, requiring only direct recall and a basic calculation.
